method: Observation-only browser listeners recorded native HTMLMediaElement play, playing, timeupdate, pause and ended events. Original playback methods remained in use; audio was neither mocked nor generated. API routes /api/voice and /api/story were guarded before navigation.

observations.interaction: Played the visible tracing instruction, then used confirmed Back to world while playback was active.
observations.evidence: Same-origin packaged MP3 request; play/playing and timeupdate observed, followed by pause during exit. A rapid exit observation paused at approximately 0.24 seconds, then reset to 0.
observations.limitation: No human listening review; one letter run only.

observations.interaction: Played the visible instruction during a normal round, then confirmed exit.
observations.evidence: Same-origin packaged MP3 request; native play/playing/timeupdate and pause at exit observed.
observations.limitation: No human listening review; this confirms the exercised instruction only.

observations.interaction: Used Show hint and immediately confirmed Leave board.
observations.evidence: Same-origin packaged hint audio; native play/playing and pause at exit observed, with currentTime at 0 when paused.
observations.limitation: No human listening review; hint playback and one cancellation path only.

observations.interaction: Used Read clue and confirmed Back to world while the clue was active.
observations.evidence: Same-origin packaged clue MP3; native play/playing/timeupdate and pause on exit observed. In a separate clue playback, time advanced to about 2.55 seconds before pause/end.

network: The observed media requests were same-origin packaged assets. No /api/voice or /api/story provider calls were made; both routes remained guarded with 204 responses.
